owner: Task projection, plugin result evaluation, retention service, and task-detail UI
problem: The accepted quality gate missed excessive detail whitespace, internal variable provenance, ambiguous timestamps, missing VCS/UVM log semantics, and the three-day retention default.
scope: Task list expansion, computed-field projection, VCS plugin discovery/evaluation, honest stopping and process-tree confirmation, interactive controls, tag serialization, task metadata and terminal-output retention, long-running resource health, and the 29049 live instance.
baseline: The current live page is the failure baseline: expanded task detail contains a large bottom gap, start time behaves like a copyable code value, and variable_sources is visible.
benchmarks: Semantic HTML disclosure whose height is content-owned
VCS compile/run logs with explicit phase ownership
advantages: Existing plugin snapshots already support arbitrary statuses
Existing task custom fields and log files provide stable persistence owners
Existing Edge gate can measure geometry and visible text
disadvantages: Current custom projection does not distinguish internal provenance from plugin output
Current browser gate checks presence more strongly than content-owned height
limitations: VCS itself is unavailable on this Windows development host
Log classification must be validated with representative fixtures rather than running a licensed simulator
Plugin status can only use evidence present in configured log files
defects: Expanded detail has unowned blank space
Retention default and paired cleanup are not yet verified as three days
bottlenecks: UI geometry Oracle does not reject bottom gaps
Result evaluation lacks a phase-aware log model
Retention tests may verify cleanup categories separately instead of task-level atomic intent

metrics.name: expanded_detail_bottom_gap
metrics.measurement: Rendered detail bounding box bottom minus last visible child bottom

metrics.name: internal_projection_leaks
metrics.measurement: Visible task-detail fields named variable_sources or undeclared internal keys
metrics.evidence: Frontend component test and Edge text assertion

metrics.name: vcs_status_fixture_accuracy
metrics.measurement: Compile-only, PASS, ERROR, FATAL, non-UVM error, missing-path and multiple-log fixtures

metrics.name: retention_pair_integrity
metrics.measurement: Expired terminal task loses metadata and output together; active and younger tasks retain both

metrics.name: false_cancelled_transitions
metrics.measurement: A running task remains stopping until executor wait or explicit process-tree plus exit confirmation completes
metrics.evidence: Scheduler integration and Ubuntu systemd target tests

metrics.name: idle_resource_budget_failures
metrics.measurement: Service RSS/CPU and Edge CPU/heap/DOM/request/WebSocket measurements with zero active tasks

hypotheses: Removing min-height/flex growth from the expanded owner will eliminate the blank gap without hiding content
A plugin-declared computed list will prevent variable_sources leakage
Parsing the last UVM report summary before fallback fatal/error patterns will avoid stale earlier messages
One task retention duration with a three-day default can drive metadata and log cleanup consistently

stages.input: Frozen user-visible failures and UVM/VCS questions
stages.output: Source matrix and phase-aware result contract
stages.checker: Sources cover official, implementation, engineering, counterexample, and local fixture levels
stages.rollback: Keep the goal active and do not implement a guessed parser

stages.output: VCS plugin, computed projection, three-day paired cleanup
stages.checker: Unit and integration fixtures accept all successes and reject all failures
stages.rollback: Revert the failing owner only and retain the old live service

stages.input: Task detail projection without internal keys
stages.output: Content-owned detail with static timestamps and conditional computed rows
stages.checker: Wide and narrow Edge geometry, text, accessibility, and current-build assertions
stages.rollback: Restore the prior CSS bundle while keeping backend tests and goal active

stages.input: All local gates passed and no active task
stages.output: 29049 serves the tested build and preserves history
stages.checker: Admin status, build identity, task/log retention, and live browser geometry
stages.rollback: Restart the last known working source tree and report the blocker

hard_gates: Known blank-gap and internal-field failure fixtures are rejected
Three-day default and paired retention behavior pass
Stopping is observable before cancellation and cancellation follows real executor completion
Ctrl+D closes the interactive example and tag-derived mutex keys serialize matching simulations
Idle resource receipt passes without hidden terminal connections
Current assets are built before Edge runs
The live 29049 process is restarted only with zero active tasks
failure_fixtures: Expanded detail whose bottom gap exceeds 16 px
Compile logs exist but no run log exists
Last UVM summary contains nonzero UVM_ERROR or UVM_FATAL
Expired task metadata deleted while its terminal output remains
success_fixtures: Compact task detail with no computed fields
Multiple compile logs and no run log classified as compilation error
Run log with final zero-count UVM summary classified PASS
Run log with non-UVM VCS error classified ERROR
Terminal task younger than three days retains metadata and output
fault_injections: Project all custom keys instead of plugin-declared computed keys
Parse the first rather than last UVM report summary
Delete only the database record or only the output directory
Change the retention default from three days
rollback: Do not replace the live service until the complete candidate passes; if live startup fails, restart the prior tested process command against the unchanged runtime root.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: Any repeated failure changes owner, representation, or Oracle rather than retuning the same threshold

stop_conditions: Known failures rejected and successes accepted at 100 percent
Parent quality gate and Edge gate pass on current assets
Live 29049 instance exposes the tested behavior with no residual process
Design, goal, worklog, user docs, plugin docs and quality registry agree

promotion_decision.destination: modern-web-interface-design and localflow project skill references
promotion_decision.reason: Content-owned disclosure geometry is cross-project; VCS/UVM specifics are project-domain knowledge

writeback: Project-specific evidence stays in project goals/worklog; generic detail-density Oracle returns to modern-web-interface-design if validated; VCS/UVM contract is documented in LocalFlow plugin docs and project skill.
